WITH window_tx AS (
  SELECT id, amount_kobo, fee_kobo
  FROM processor.transactions
  WHERE status = 'success'
    AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 23:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 23:00:00'

expected AS (

WITH proc_success AS (
  SELECT
    reference,
    COUNT(*) AS proc_count,
    SUM(amount_kobo - fee_kobo) AS proc_net_kobo
  FROM processor.transactions
  WHERE status = 'success'
    AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-20 23:00:00'
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-21 23:00:00'
  GROUP BY reference
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
bank_lines AS (
  SELECT
    UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(matched_reference, '^REF/', '')) AS matched_reference,
    COUNT(*) AS bank_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(amount_kobo), 0) AS bank_total_kobo
  FROM bank.settlement_lines
  WHERE value_date = DATE '2026-10-21'
  GROUP BY UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(matched_reference, '^REF/', ''))
)
SELECT
  p.reference AS matched_reference,
  p.proc_count,
  COALESCE(b.bank_count, 0) AS bank_count,
  p.proc_net_kobo,
  COALESCE(b.bank_total_kobo, 0) AS bank_total_kobo,
  p.proc_net_kobo - COALESCE(b.bank_total_kobo, 0) AS gap_kobo
FROM proc_success p
LEFT JOIN bank_lines b
  ON b.matched_reference = p.reference
WHERE p.proc_count > COALESCE(b.bank_count, 0)

narrative.text: The 2026-10-21 settlement differs by NGN 4,200,000.00. NGN 1,800,000.00 is explained by a successful transaction with no bank settlement line [E2, E6]. NGN 1,500,000.00 is explained by transactions that succeeded after the bank cutoff and settled a day late [E3, E7]. NGN 700,000.00 is explained by a retried webhook that created a duplicate credit [E4, E8]. NGN 200,000.00 is explained by a higher fee rate applied by the bank [E5, E9]. The gap is fully explained.

Subject: Missing settlement line, value date 2026-10-21

Our ledger shows a successful transaction of 180000000 kobo with no matching line in your settlement file. No line on any value date carries this amount. Please confirm whether it was paid and under which reference. Evidence: E2, E6.

actions.title: Note timing difference, no recovery needed
actions.draft: These 150000000 kobo settled one value date late because they succeeded after the 20:00 UTC bank cutoff (21:00 West Africa Time). No money is missing. Add a cutoff-aware rule to the daily reconciliation. Evidence: E3, E7.

actions.draft: Reversal request for 2026-10-21: a retried webhook created a second success and ledger credit worth 70000000 kobo. The bank paid once. Reverse the second credit and enforce idempotency on the webhook handler. Evidence: E4, E8.
